question: What is the absolute percent difference between the total federal expenditures reported in February 1938 and January 1939, rounded to the nearest tenths place in millions of dollars?
raw_response:
The value is exactly 31.25, sitting on the rounding boundary. Per standard rounding convention (round half up), this rounds to 31.3.

Total Federal Expenditures (basis of daily Treasury statements):
- Feb 1938: 528 million
- Jan 1939: 693 million
- Absolute % difference = 165/528 × 100 = 31.25% → 31.3

<FINAL_ANSWER>31.3</FINAL_ANSWER>
